{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Water Rooster''' (癸酉, ''mizunoto tori''; onyomi ''kiyū'') is the 10th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 10th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Water Monkey|ja|壬申}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Wood Dog|ja|甲戌}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''癸'' is Yin Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''酉'' (Rooster) is Yin Metal; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Water Rooster (癸酉)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): guǐyǒu
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gwai2 jau5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoto-tori
*** On'yomi: kiyū
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gye-yu (계유)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Quý Dậu

==Months of Yin Water Rooster==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 4 or 9 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kinoe (甲)|ja|甲|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoto (己)|ja|己|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ki}}), the month of {{ill|August|en|August|qid=Q122|lt=August}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of {{ill|Yin Water Rooster|ja|癸酉|5-癸酉|en|2=ja|3=癸酉|4=zh|6=ko|7=계유|lt_ko=계유|8=fr|9=Coq de eau|10=de|11=Wasser-Hahn|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin Water Rooster}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Bailu (solar term)|en|Bailu (solar term)|qid=Q1191003|lt=White Dew}} until the day before {{ill|Hanlu|en|Hanlu|qid=Q1193124|lt=Lesser Cold}}) as applicable.
